caption: The drawing features a garment resembling a cloak or cape, depicted in shades of brown and beige with a subtle gradient, giving it a textured, fabric-like appearance. The cloak has a round collar, an open front, and is fastened at the neckline by a bow made from the same material, colored in a similar brown tone. The left side of the cloak is drawn to show the inner lining, which appears slightly lighter in color. In the upper right corner, there is a smaller, line-drawn sketch that shows a simplified side view of the same garment. In the bottom left corner, there is a rectangular swatch displaying the cloak’s fabric pattern, consisting of vertical stripes in different shades of brown. The background of the drawing is a light beige tone, and the entire composition is framed by a simple rectangular border.
title: Quaker Cape
